research.title: Measures — Early Years
research.adopted: From qualitative duration to consistent agreed units.
research.usageRestrictions: No protected source prose/figures copied; no redistribution licence inferred.
research.limitations: Foreign early-years guidance; age adaptation is project design, not Finnish curriculum/efficacy proof.

research.title: Timing
research.adopted: Adult-supported whole-event timing and optional physical demonstration.
research.rejected: Action counts do not alone measure elapsed time.
research.usageRestrictions: No protected source prose/figures copied; no redistribution licence inferred.
research.limitations: Physical proficiency cannot be inferred from on-screen readout checks.

research.title: Beat the Clock
research.adopted: Contrast variable action rhythms with one measured duration.
research.rejected: No mandatory speed competition or motor-performance threshold.
research.usageRestrictions: No protected source prose/figures copied; no redistribution licence inferred.
research.limitations: Illustrative cadence/model parameters are project design, not empirical measurements.
